title: Insights View Integration for Playwright Functional Tests
description: Verify that the Insights view component properly integrates and displays Playwright functional test results
testDescription: This test validates that the Insights view correctly integrates with Playwright functional test results and displays them accurately within the existing UI framework
prerequisites:
1. Playwright test framework must be set up and running
2. Existing Insights view for Unit, Integration, and API tests must be operational
3. Sample functional tests must be available with various test statuses (passed, failed, skipped)
stepsToPerform:
1. Execute a sample set of Playwright functional tests
2. Navigate to the Insights dashboard
3. Locate and click on the Functional Test category in the Insights navigation
4. Verify the functional test results are displayed
5. Compare displayed results with actual test execution output
expectedResult:
1. Functional test section should be visible in Insights view
2. Test results should accurately match the actual execution results
3. UI presentation should be consistent with other test types (Unit, Integration, API)
4. All test statuses should be correctly color-coded and represented
securityConsiderations: Ensure sensitive test data is properly masked in the Insights view
browserRequirements: Test must pass on Chrome, Firefox, and Safari browsers
riskLevel: High - This is a core functionality for test result visualization
impactAreas: Test Reporting, Data Visualization, Test Results Analysis

title: Filtering and Navigation in Functional Test Insights View
description: Validate filter functionality and navigation controls within the Functional test section of Insights view
testDescription: This test ensures that users can effectively filter, sort, and navigate through functional test results in the Insights view
prerequisites:
1. Playwright functional tests must be executed and results available in the Insights view
2. Multiple test results with different statuses must be present
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the Insights dashboard and select Functional Test section
2. Test filtering by test status (pass, fail, skip)
3. Filter by test duration (shortest to longest, longest to shortest)
4. Filter by test name/description
5. Navigate between pages of test results if pagination is present
6. Clear all filters and verify full results are restored
expectedResult:
1. Filters should correctly limit displayed results based on selected criteria
2. Sorting options should reorder the displayed results as expected
3. Text search should find matching test names/descriptions
4. Pagination controls should work correctly if present
5. Clearing filters should restore complete result set
performanceRequirements: Filter operations should complete within 2 seconds even with large result sets
usabilityConsiderations: Filter controls should be intuitive and consistent with existing Insights view for other test types
edgeCaseConsiderations: Test with empty result sets and with very large result sets to verify UI behavior
accessibilityRequirements: All filter controls must be keyboard-navigable and screen reader compatible

title: Cross-navigation Between Test Types in Insights View
description: Verify seamless navigation between different test types (Unit, Integration, API, and Functional) in the Insights view
testDescription: This test ensures that users can easily switch between different test type views while maintaining context and applied filters where appropriate
prerequisites:
1. Test results must be available for all test types (Unit, Integration, API, and Functional)
2. User must have permissions to view all test types
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the Insights dashboard
2. Select Functional Test view and apply some filters
3. Navigate to Unit Test view
4. Apply different filters in Unit Test view
5. Return to Functional Test view
6. Navigate to Integration Test view
7. Navigate to API Test view
8. Return to Functional Test view again
expectedResult:
1. Navigation between test types should be smooth and responsive
2. Each test type should maintain its own filter state
3. When returning to a previously viewed test type, its last filter state should be preserved
4. Visual indicators should clearly show which test type view is currently active
5. The UI should maintain consistent layout and structure across all test types
performanceConsiderations: View switching should occur within 1 second
usabilityRequirements: Active view should be clearly highlighted in the navigation
dataConsistencyRequirements: Test counts and summary statistics should match across different views of the same data
responsiveDesignRequirements: Navigation should adapt appropriately on different screen sizes

title: Detailed Test Information Display in Functional Insights View
description: Validate that detailed test information is correctly displayed when selecting a specific functional test in the Insights view
testDescription: This test verifies that when a user selects an individual functional test from the Insights view, all relevant details are correctly displayed, including steps, screenshots, logs, and error information
prerequisites:
1. Playwright functional tests with comprehensive details (steps, screenshots, logs) must be executed
2. Tests with both passing and failing statuses should be available
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the Functional Test section in the Insights view
2. Select a passing test from the list
3. View all available information
4. Return to the test list
5. Select a failing test from the list
6. View all available information including error details
7. Test any interactive elements in the detailed view (e.g., image viewers, log expanders)
expectedResult:
1. Detailed view should show all test steps executed
2. Screenshots should be displayed when available and properly sized
3. Logs should be formatted and readable
4. For failing tests, error information should be highlighted and easily identifiable
5. All interactive elements should function correctly
6. Navigation back to the test list should be intuitive
dataRequirements: Test detail view must include: test name, duration, status, steps performed, assertions, screenshots, console logs, and network logs where available
visualRequirements: Failed steps should be highlighted in red, passed steps in green
interactiveFeatures: Screenshots should be expandable to full size on click
accessibilityRequirements: All test details must be accessible via keyboard navigation and readable by screen readers

title: Functional Test Insights Data Export Functionality
description: Verify that functional test results can be correctly exported from the Insights view in various formats
testDescription: This test validates the ability to export functional test results from the Insights view in different formats and ensures the exported data is complete and accurate
prerequisites:
1. Playwright functional tests must be executed with diverse results
2. User must have export permissions
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the Functional Test section in the Insights view
2. Apply various filters to create a specific result subset
3. Locate and click the Export button
4. Select CSV format and export
5. Select JSON format and export
6. Select HTML report format and export (if available)
7. Select PDF format and export (if available)
8. Verify the content of each exported file
expectedResult:
1. Export functionality should be available for all supported formats
2. Exported data should match the currently filtered view in the UI
3. CSV format should include all relevant columns and data
4. JSON format should contain complete test information
5. HTML/PDF reports should be well-formatted and include all relevant test details
6. All exports should properly handle special characters and formatting
securityConsiderations: Exported files should not contain sensitive information beyond what is visible in the UI
performanceRequirements: Export generation should complete within 10 seconds for datasets up to 1000 test results
fileFormatRequirements: CSV files should use proper escaping for special characters, JSON files should be valid and parsable
edgeCaseConsiderations: Export should handle very large result sets and results with extensive logs or many screenshots

title: Real-time Test Status Updates in Insights View
description: Verify that the Insights view updates in real-time as Playwright functional tests are executed
testDescription: This test validates that the Insights view displays real-time updates when functional tests are running, allowing users to monitor test progress without waiting for full test completion
prerequisites:
1. Playwright test framework must be configured
2. Insights view integration for functional tests must be enabled
3. Test suite with multiple long-running tests must be available
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the Insights dashboard
2. Initiate a Playwright functional test suite execution
3. Immediately navigate to the Functional Test section in Insights view
4. Observe the test results as they come in
5. Verify that status indicators update as tests complete
6. Verify test count summaries (passed/failed/running/pending) update dynamically
7. Wait for all tests to complete and verify final state
expectedResult:
1. Tests should appear in the Insights view as they begin execution
2. Status indicators should update in real-time (pending → running → passed/failed)
3. Summary statistics should update dynamically as test statuses change
4. No page refresh should be required to see updates
5. Final test results should match actual execution outcomes
performanceRequirements: Updates should appear within 3 seconds of test status changes
edgeCaseConsiderations: System should handle test timeouts and interrupted test executions properly
technicalConstraints: Real-time updates should not significantly impact browser performance

title: Trend Analysis for Functional Tests in Insights View
description: Validate the trend analysis functionality for historical Playwright functional test results in the Insights view
testDescription: This test ensures that the Insights view correctly displays historical trends for functional test results, allowing users to analyze performance patterns over time
prerequisites:
1. Multiple functional test runs must be available in the system
2. Test history data must span at least 7 days
3. There must be a mix of passed, failed, and flaky tests in the history
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the Insights dashboard
2. Select the Functional Test section
3. Locate and click on the Trends tab/view
4. Verify the trend visualization for all tests
5. Filter to view trends for specific test categories or tags
6. Select different time ranges (last day, week, month)
7. Hover over data points to view detailed information
8. Click on specific trend points to view the associated test run details
expectedResult:
1. Trend graphs should accurately display historical test pass/fail rates
2. Data points should match the actual historical test results
3. Time range filters should adjust the displayed data appropriately
4. Hover tooltips should provide detailed information for each data point
5. Clicking on trend points should navigate to the specific test run details
6. Trend analysis should identify and highlight potentially flaky tests
dataVisualizationRequirements: Graphs should use appropriate colors (green for pass, red for fail, amber for flaky)
dataAccuracyRequirements: All trend data must match actual historical test results with 100% accuracy
usabilityRequirements: Trend visualizations should be intuitive and include proper labeling of axes and data points

title: Error Pattern Recognition in Functional Test Insights
description: Verify that the Insights view can identify and categorize common error patterns in Playwright functional tests
testDescription: This test validates the ability of the Insights view to analyze test failures, identify common error patterns, and present meaningful categorizations to help with troubleshooting
prerequisites:
1. Multiple functional test runs with various failure types must be available
2. Error pattern recognition feature must be enabled in the Insights view configuration
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the Insights dashboard
2. Select the Functional Test section
3. Navigate to the Error Analysis view
4. Verify that common error types are categorized (e.g., network errors, assertion failures, element not found)
5. Select a specific error category
6. Review the tests grouped under this category
7. Verify error details and suggestions are provided
8. Test the search functionality within error patterns
9. Verify error trend analysis over time
expectedResult:
1. Error pattern recognition should correctly categorize different types of test failures
2. Similar errors should be grouped together regardless of which test they occurred in
3. Error categories should be clearly labeled and ordered by frequency
4. Selecting a category should show all tests with that error type
5. Detailed error information should include stack traces and relevant context
6. Potential solutions or troubleshooting steps should be suggested where applicable
7. Error trends over time should be accurately displayed
aiRequirements: Pattern recognition should use intelligent algorithms to group similar but not identical errors
troubleshootingValue: Error analysis should provide actionable insights to resolve common failures
dataPrivacyRequirements: Error details should not expose sensitive information from test data

title: Custom Dashboard Creation for Functional Test Insights
description: Validate that users can create and save custom dashboards focused on specific aspects of functional test results
testDescription: This test ensures users can create personalized dashboards in the Insights view that highlight specific metrics, test categories, or focus areas relevant to their role
prerequisites:
1. User must have permissions to create custom dashboards
2. Functional test results must be available in the system
3. Dashboard customization feature must be enabled
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the Insights dashboard
2. Select the Functional Test section
3. Locate and click on 'Create Custom Dashboard' option
4. Add various widgets to the dashboard (test summary, trend charts, recent failures, etc.)
5. Configure each widget with specific filters and parameters
6. Arrange the layout of the dashboard
7. Save the custom dashboard with a unique name
8. Navigate away and then return to verify dashboard persistence
9. Edit the dashboard to add/remove widgets
10. Share the dashboard with another user if sharing functionality exists
expectedResult:
1. Custom dashboard creation interface should be intuitive and responsive
2. All available widget types should be functional when added
3. Widget configurations should persist and correctly filter data
4. Dashboard layout should be flexible and save properly
5. Saved dashboards should be accessible from a dashboard list/menu
6. Dashboard should load quickly and display accurate data
7. Dashboard editing should work correctly
8. If sharing is available, shared users should be able to view but not edit unless given permission
widgetRequirements: Available widgets should include: test summary statistics, pass/fail trends, test duration metrics, most frequent failures, recent test runs
personalizationRequirements: Users should be able to name dashboards and set one as their default view
performanceRequirements: Custom dashboards should load within 3 seconds even with multiple widgets

title: Test Environment Comparison in Functional Test Insights
description: Verify that the Insights view allows comparison of test results across different environments and configurations
testDescription: This test validates that users can compare functional test results from different environments (dev, staging, production) or configurations (browsers, devices) to identify environment-specific issues
prerequisites:
1. Functional tests must be executed across multiple environments or configurations
2. Test results from all environments must be available in the system
3. Environment metadata must be properly tagged in test results
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the Insights dashboard
2. Select the Functional Test section
3. Locate and select the Environment Comparison view
4. Select two or more environments/configurations to compare
5. Review the comparison visualization for pass/fail rates
6. Identify tests that fail in one environment but pass in others
7. Filter comparison to specific test categories or tags
8. Export the comparison results if export functionality exists
expectedResult:
1. Environment comparison view should clearly display differences in test results
2. Tests with different outcomes across environments should be highlighted
3. Summary statistics should show pass/fail/skip rates by environment
4. Filtering should work correctly to focus on specific test subsets
5. Detailed information should be available for tests with different outcomes
6. Visual indicators should make it easy to spot environment-specific issues
7. If available, export functionality should include all comparison data
analyticalRequirements: System should automatically highlight the most significant differences between environments
visualRequirements: Comparison view should use color coding and clear labels to make differences obvious
dataAccuracyRequirements: All comparison data must accurately reflect the actual test results from each environment

title: Test Execution Timeline Visualization in Insights View
description: Verify that the Insights view displays an accurate timeline visualization of functional test execution
testDescription: This test validates that the Insights view provides a clear timeline visualization showing when functional tests were executed, their duration, and parallel execution patterns
prerequisites:
1. Multiple Playwright functional test runs with timestamp data must be available
2. Tests with varying durations must be present
3. Some tests must have been executed in parallel
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the Insights dashboard
2. Select the Functional Test section
3. Locate and click on the 'Execution Timeline' view
4. Observe the timeline visualization for all test runs
5. Hover over individual test blocks to view detailed timing information
6. Verify parallel test execution is correctly represented
7. Adjust the timeline view to different time ranges (hour, day, week)
8. Filter the timeline by specific test suites or tags
expectedResult:
1. Timeline should display all test executions as blocks on a time-based axis
2. Test block lengths should accurately represent test durations
3. Parallel test executions should be displayed on separate lanes
4. Hover tooltips should show precise start/end times and duration
5. Time scale adjustments should correctly zoom in/out on the timeline
6. Filters should correctly limit displayed test executions
7. Color coding should indicate test status (passed/failed/skipped)
visualRequirements: Timeline should use a clear visual design with distinct colors for different test statuses
dataAccuracyRequirements: All timing information must match actual test execution logs with precision to the second
interactiveFeatures: Timeline should support zooming, panning, and clicking through to detailed test information
performanceConsiderations: Timeline should render efficiently even when displaying hundreds of test executions

title: Test Flakiness Analysis in Functional Test Insights
description: Validate the flakiness detection and analysis features for Playwright functional tests in the Insights view
testDescription: This test ensures that the Insights view can identify flaky functional tests (tests with inconsistent results) and provide detailed analysis to help resolve flakiness issues
prerequisites:
1. Multiple runs of the same functional tests must be available
2. Some tests must have inconsistent results across runs (sometimes passing, sometimes failing)
3. Flakiness analysis feature must be enabled
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the Insights dashboard
2. Select the Functional Test section
3. Locate and click on the 'Flakiness Analysis' view
4. Review the list of identified flaky tests
5. Check the flakiness score/percentage for each test
6. Select a specific flaky test to view detailed analysis
7. Review the test execution history showing pass/fail patterns
8. Check for any automatic flakiness cause detection
9. Verify recommendations for reducing flakiness if available
expectedResult:
1. Flaky tests should be correctly identified based on inconsistent results
2. Flakiness score should accurately reflect the percentage of inconsistent outcomes
3. Tests should be sortable by flakiness score
4. Detailed view should show a clear pattern of test outcomes over time
5. System should identify potential causes of flakiness where possible
6. Historical data should be accurate and match actual test runs
7. Recommendations for fixing flakiness should be relevant and actionable
analyticalCapabilities: System should use statistical methods to identify truly flaky tests vs. tests failing due to actual changes
dataVisualizationRequirements: Flakiness patterns should be visualized in an intuitive way showing pass/fail alternation
actionableInsights: Analysis should provide specific suggestions for addressing common causes of test flakiness
historicalDataRequirements: System should analyze at least 10 previous runs to establish flakiness patterns

title: Test Performance Metrics Analysis in Insights View
description: Verify that the Insights view provides detailed performance metrics for Playwright functional tests
testDescription: This test validates that the Insights view accurately captures and displays performance metrics for functional tests, including execution time, resource usage, and bottlenecks
prerequisites:
1. Functional tests with performance metrics collection enabled must be executed
2. Test runs must include timing data for individual steps
3. Performance metrics feature must be configured in Insights view
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the Insights dashboard
2. Select the Functional Test section
3. Locate and click on the 'Performance Analysis' view
4. Review overall performance metrics for all tests
5. Identify the slowest tests in the test suite
6. Select a specific test to view detailed performance breakdown
7. Analyze step-by-step execution times
8. Review any resource utilization graphs (CPU, memory, network)
9. Check performance trends over time for specific tests
expectedResult:
1. Performance metrics should be accurately displayed for all tests
2. Slowest tests should be correctly identified and ranked
3. Detailed view should break down execution time by test step
4. Resource utilization data should be correctly graphed if available
5. Performance bottlenecks should be highlighted
6. Historical performance trends should accurately reflect changes over time
7. Performance data should match actual execution metrics from test logs
performanceIndicators: System should track and display key metrics: total execution time, setup time, teardown time, step execution times, idle waiting time, resource utilization
benchmarkingCapabilities: System should establish performance baselines and highlight significant deviations
dataVisualizationRequirements: Performance data should be presented with clear graphs and visual indicators for problematic areas
analyticalInsights: System should suggest potential optimization opportunities for slow tests

title: Cross-Browser Comparison in Functional Test Insights
description: Validate that the Insights view can effectively compare functional test results across different browsers
testDescription: This test ensures that the Insights view provides clear comparisons of test results when the same functional tests are executed across different browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)
prerequisites:
1. Same functional tests must be executed on multiple browsers
2. Test results from all browser runs must be available in the system
3. Browser information must be properly tagged in test metadata
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the Insights dashboard
2. Select the Functional Test section
3. Locate and click on the 'Browser Comparison' view
4. Review the matrix showing test results across browsers
5. Identify tests that fail in some browsers but pass in others
6. Filter results by specific test categories or tags
7. Select a browser-specific failure to view detailed information
8. Compare screenshots across browsers if available
9. Review browser-specific error messages
expectedResult:
1. Browser comparison view should clearly show test results across all browsers
2. Tests with inconsistent results across browsers should be highlighted
3. Filtering should correctly limit the displayed test results
4. Detailed view for browser-specific failures should show relevant information
5. If available, screenshots should be displayed side by side for comparison
6. Browser-specific error messages should be clearly presented
7. Summary statistics should show pass/fail rates by browser
crossBrowserRequirements: System should support comparison across all major browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)
visualComparisonCapabilities: System should provide visual diff tools for comparing screenshots across browsers
analyticalInsights: System should highlight patterns in browser-specific failures (e.g., all CSS flex issues in Safari)
dataVisualizationRequirements: Browser comparison matrix should use clear visual indicators for passed/failed states across browsers

title: User Permission Controls for Functional Test Insights
description: Verify that appropriate user permission controls are applied to the Functional Test section in the Insights view
testDescription: This test validates that user permissions are correctly enforced for accessing, modifying, and sharing functional test insights, ensuring that sensitive test data is only visible to authorized users
prerequisites:
1. Multiple user accounts with different permission levels must exist
2. Functional test results must be available in the system
3. Permission system must be configured for the Insights view
stepsToPerform:
1. Log in with an admin user account
2. Navigate to the Insights dashboard and verify full access to Functional Test section
3. Configure permissions for a specific test category to be restricted
4. Log out and log in with a user account that has standard permissions
5. Verify access to unrestricted test results and blocked access to restricted tests
6. Test export functionality with the standard user account
7. Test dashboard creation and sharing with the standard user account
8. Log out and log in with a user account that has read-only permissions
9. Verify read-only access prevents modifications but allows viewing
10. Log out and log in with a user account that has no permissions
11. Verify the Functional Test section is either hidden or access is denied
expectedResult:
1. Admin users should have full access to all functional test results and features
2. Standard users should only see test results for which they have permission
3. Restricted test categories should be hidden or access denied for unauthorized users
4. Read-only users should be able to view but not modify dashboards or settings
5. Export functionality should respect user permissions for data access
6. Dashboard sharing should only work for users with appropriate permissions
7. Users with no permissions should not be able to access the Functional Test section
8. Permission changes should take effect immediately without requiring system restart
securityRequirements: All permission checks must be enforced server-side, not just in the UI
auditingCapabilities: System should log all permission-related access attempts and changes
dataPrivacyRequirements: Sensitive test data should never be visible to unauthorized users even in summary statistics
userExperienceConsiderations: UI should gracefully handle cases where users have partial permissions, clearly indicating which features are unavailable
